output.title: disableHTTPChallengesRole helm value is already set in your values
output.content: The change adds the `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` helm value, which lets cert-manager drop its permission to create pods when HTTP-01 challenges are not required. The environment's values already set the key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`. Inspect the value assigned to it and confirm that no Issuer relies on HTTP-01 ACME challenges, since disabling the role would remove the permission those challenges need. The environment summary lists key paths only, not their values.
